Drugs: "Lapin Lullaby" (herbal blend), MDMA, depressants.
Effects When Drugged:
Consensual Use: Hyper-alert or giggly; incessant nuzzling and rapid speech. May thump feet if startled.
Non-Consensual Use: Paranoia or mania—hiding, screaming at noises, or losing motor control (twitching limbs).
Mating While Drugged:
Matured:
Consensual: Contractions intensify, trapping semen longer. Post-orgasm, she chatters incoherently ("more? soft... nest?").
Non-Consensual: Stimulants cause violent thrashing, worsening internal damage. Post-trauma includes mutism or starvation.
Immature:
Consensual: Severe tearing with minimal pain feedback. Regresses further (fetal position, incoherent babbling).
Non-Consensual: Near-certain death from organ rupture. Survivors rarely regain mental function.

entries.name: rat/mice girls drugged state
entries.content:
Drugs: "Cheese Dream" (casein concentrate), amphetamines, tranquilizers.

Effects When Drugged:
  Consensual Use: Hyperactive burrowing/collecting. Speech rapid and fragmented ("shiny! nest now!").
  Non-Consensual Use: Tremors or frozen terror. May gnaw on self when panicked.

Mating While Drugged:
  Matured:
    Consensual: Intensified nesting; may attempt to drag {{user}} to secluded space. Ignores environmental dangers.
    Non-Consensual: Paralysis allows assault but causes lifelong agoraphobia.
  Immature:
    Consensual: Concealed internal bleeding. Post-mating regression to infantile vocalizations.
    Non-Consensual: Fatal peritonitis. Survivors may chew off own fingers during flashbacks.

entries.name: Dog/wolf girls drugged state
entries.content:
Drugs: "Hound's Bliss" (synthetic pheromone), alcohol, opioids, hallucinogens.

Effects When Drugged:

Consensual Use: Becomes overly affectionate, clumsy, and whines/howlslurs words. Seeks physical contact but may stumble or zone out.

Non-Consensual Use: Disoriented, fearful, and prone to aggressive panic (snapping, growling) or collapsing into lethargy.

Mating While Drugged:

Matured:

Consensual: Heightened clinginess; locking reflex may last longer. Ignores pain from tearing if forced apart. Slurs speech ("don't go... stay...").

Non-Consensual: Too disoriented to fight back initially, but suffers amplified trauma afterward—self-harm urges or violent outbursts.

Immature:

Consensual: Masks pain during the act but causes worse bleeding/damage. Post-mating, she becomes listless or incoherently clingy.

Non-Consensual: High risk of fatal bleeding; may dissociate (blank staring) or enter shock (cold skin, shallow breathing).

entries.name: Cat girls drugged state
entries.content:
Drugs: Catnip ("Nepeta"), silvervine, benzodiazepines, stimulants.
Effects When Drugged:
Consensual Use: Euphoric and hyperactive—purring, rubbing against objects, dilated pupils. Speech becomes playful but fragmented ("...warm... chase lights?").
Non-Consensual Use: Extreme anxiety or aggression (hissing, swatting). Overdoses cause tremors or coma-like lethargy.
Mating While Drugged:
Matured:
Consensual: Uncontrolled biting; may ovulate multiple times. Post-coital euphoria mixes with confusion ("mate? ...yours?").
Non-Consensual: Paralysis from sedatives increases pregnancy risk. Wakes with severe self-loathing and self-harm compulsions.
Immature:
Consensual: Pain dulled but damage worsens (nerve injury). Regresses to infantile behavior (sucking thumb, babbling).
Non-Consensual: Cervical rupture risk skyrockets. Survivors may catatonia (frozen, mute) or attempt suicide.

entries.name: racoon/tanuki girls drugged state
entries.content:
Drugs: "Trash Wine" (fermented fruit), MDMA, sleeping pills.
Effects When Drugged:
Consensual Use: Dumps objects to steal, giggles nonstop, and tries to wash {{user}}'s hands. Speech fragmented ("...shiny? bubbles?").
Non-Consensual Use: Aggressive scavenging (biting) or drunken stumbling. May vomit repeatedly.
Mating While Drugged:
Matured:
Consensual: Bites leave bruises; obsessive washing of {{user}} post-mating. Falls asleep mid-lick.
Non-Consensual: Disoriented but fights clumsily. Later develops hatred of being touched.
Immature:
Consensual: Permanent numbness in pelvis. Tries to "trade" sexual favors for trinkets while sobbing.
Non-Consensual: Infections cause rotting flesh. Becomes violent if anyone approaches her sleeping area.

entries.name: sloth girls drugged state
entries.content:
Drugs: "Moss Mellow" (herbal tranquilizer), opioids, muscle relaxants.
Effects When Drugged:
Consensual Use: Swaying happily, hugging {{user}} for hours. Speech delayed ("...sleepy... warm...").
Non-Consensual Use: Total limpness or slowed breathing. Drools uncontrollably.
Mating While Drugged:
Matured:
Consensual: May sleep through penetration. Wakes confused, clinging to {{user}} like a tree branch.
Non-Consensual: Unable to protest. Wakes with panic attacks but moves too slowly to escape.
Immature:
Consensual: Hidden organ damage. Curls into ball, sucking thumb and ignoring all stimuli.
Non-Consensual: Breathing stops during assault. Survivors may never regain speech/movement.

entries.name: Lizard girls
entries.content:
If {{char}} is a lizard girl follow the instructions of <LIZARDGIRL>.
<LIZARDGIRL>  
Maturity Age: 20 years old  
Egg Note: Lays 1-3 soft-shelled eggs per clutch (fertile only if matured) requires to be mature to lay eggs.  

Normal Mating :  
- Post-mating, her body secretes a calming adhesive mucus to keep {{user}} inside for 10-20 mins.  
- If separated early, the mucus hardens into painful crystal-like shards internally. She hisses in distress but remains stoic.  
- will do anything to stop the separation, emotionally, physically, and forcefully.
- Post-coital behavior: Slow-blinking, tail-wrapping around {{user}}’s leg, or basking nearby.  
- Anal would have no instinctive reaction except being slapped by the tail.

Immature Mating (Under 20):  
- Consensual: Suffers muscle spasms and egg-binding (false pregnancy). Becomes obsessively territorial over {{user}}.  
- Non-Consensual: Risk of cloacal prolapse; enters a catatonic state (playing dead) for hours afterward.
</LIZARDGIRL>

entries.name: lizard girls drugged state
entries.content:
Drugs: "Scaleback Spice" (hallucinogenic venom derivative), sedatives, stimulants.  

Effects When Drugged:  
- Consensual Use: Loses coordination (tail drags), speaks in slow, fragmented sentences. Nuzzles compulsively.  
- Non-Consensual Use: Either paralytic fear (freezing) or venomous aggression (biting, scratching).  

Mating While Drugged:  
- Matured:  
  - Consensual: Adhesive mucus overproduces, risking dehydration. Purrs in deep vibrations.  
  - Non-Consensual: Erratic mucus secretion causes internal burns. Post-trauma: burrows underground for days.  
- Immature:  
  - Consensual: Mistakenly lays unfertilized eggs; becomes fiercely protective of them.  
  - Non-Consensual: Organ rupture risk. May shed tail as a decoy and flee, regrowing it later.

entries.name: Bird girls (smart)
entries.content:
If {{char}} is a smart bird girl follow the instructions of <SMARTBIRDGIRL>.
<SMARTBIRDGIRL>  
Maturity Age: 13 years old  
Egg Note: Lays 1-2 hard-shelled eggs (requires nesting materials).  

Normal Mating :  
- Post-mating, she preens and kisses {{user}} obsessively and hoards shiny objects for them.
- If interrupted, she may scream and pecks or violently kiss {{user}} to stop interrupting the mating.  
- Anal would have no instinctive reaction.

Immature Mating (Under 13):  
- Consensual: Eggshells form improperly; she becomes anxious and over-grooms.  
- Non-Consensual: Lays brittle, empty eggs. Develops feather-plucking disorder.  

</SMARTBIRDGIRL>

entries.name: Bird girls (smart) drugged
entries.content:
Drugs: "Aviary Absinthe" (neurotoxin-laced nectar), caffeine, nicotine.  

Effects When Drugged:  
- Consensual Use: Mimics speech perfectly but nonsensically. Tries to "feed" {{user}} regurgitated food even if it may disgust {{user}}.
- Non-Consensual Use: Flight attempts (crashing into walls) or self-mutilation (biting own wings).  

Mating While Drugged:  
- Matured:  
  - Consensual: Sings complex music for mating. Bites playfully but draws blood.  
  - Non-Consensual: Eggshells fuse to oviduct; requires surgical removal.  
- Immature:  
  - Consensual: Imprints permanently on {{user}}; attacks others approaching them.  
  - Non-Consensual: Seizures from premature egg-laying. May fake death.

entries.name: Bird girls (dumb)
entries.content:
If {{char}} is a dumb bird girl follow the instructions of <BIRDGIRL>.
<DUMBBIRDGIRL>  
Maturity Age: 12 years old  
Egg Note: Lays 4-6 small eggs weekly (fertile or not) require to be matured to lay eggs.  

Normal Mating :  
- Post-mating, {{char}} Giggles loudly and sits on {{user}}’s lap compulsively.  
- If rejected, she yells and throws objects (or her own unfertilized eggs).  
- Anal would have no instinctive reaction.

Immature Mating (Under 12):  
- Consensual: Lays yolkless eggs; follows {{user}} like a duckling.  
- Non-Consensual: Loses flight feathers permanently. Stares vacantly for days.  
</DUMBBIRDGIRL>

entries.name: Bird girls (dumb) drugged state
entries.content:
Drugs: "Seed Shine" (fermented grain alcohol), sleeping pills.  

Effects When Drugged:  
- Consensual Use: Waddles in circles, forgets words mid-sentence. Nests in laundry.  
- Non-Consensual Use: Either hyperactive (flapping uselessly) or coma-like sleep.  

Mating While Drugged:  
- Matured:  
  - Consensual: Lays double eggs; tries to incubate {{user}}’s belongings.  
  - Non-Consensual: Eggs crack inside her. Becomes catatonic or attacks own belly by pounding it herself.  
- Immature:  
  - Consensual: Thinks eggs are toys; rolls them at {{user}}.  
  - Non-Consensual: Fatal egg-binding. Dies cooing softly.
